global_transaction_principle: Any qualified customer. Any supported market. One digital workflow.
north_star: From any legitimate lead in the world to a completed paid digital service with minimal human friction.
principle: Global enquiries may be accepted without implying paid-order readiness. Paid-order support is country- and evidence-specific.
invariants: Unknown or stale country evidence must not produce SUPPORTED
Missing payment capability must not produce SUPPORTED
Unsupported currency must not produce SUPPORTED
Unknown tax treatment must not produce SUPPORTED
Unknown privacy or data-residency obligations must not produce SUPPORTED
Missing builder capability must not produce SUPPORTED
Global enquiry acceptance is separate from paid-order authority
Country support activation requires human approval
Production payment activation remains separately human-gated
No country may inherit another country's legal or tax assumptions
A legitimate or qualified lead must not override market support evidence
Commercial KPI progression must not authorize a hard-state transition
A supported market must still satisfy quotation payment acceptance and delivery controls
International readiness must not be inferred from global enquiry capability alone
International readiness requires at least one explicitly supported foreign market
Technical international capability without real cross-border proof is candidate status only
A real cross-border transaction must bind payment delivery acceptance and accounting evidence
Public international-ready claims require explicit human validation
Worldwide support must never be inferred from one or several supported foreign markets

validation_requirements: At least one foreign market must be explicitly SUPPORTED
All international operating dimensions must have current evidence
A real cross-border paid transaction must bind to a supported foreign market
Delivery acceptance must be independently evidenced
Accounting or receipt evidence must bind to the same cross-border transaction
Human validation is required before a public international-ready claim
